scope: Read-only current and historical source reconstruction. No source algorithm execution, registered test rerun, production/test/CI changes, build, GUI/process launch, actual UIKit delivery, target binary execution or device acceptance.

source_records.basis: pinned canonical LF unmodified by production overlay

frontier.established: Known inherited boundary: ordinary Node Pencil is not a paint ticket. Ordinary Cancelled/Failed path tags is_cancelled only when a valid paint contact exists.
frontier.not_established: Any new Node receipt, press lease, safe replacement cancellation target or rollback guarantee.
frontier.decision: Retain the limitation; no unleased release, replacement Cancel or generic rollback in this audit.

ordinary_corridor_preconditions: Physical Pencil contact in ordinary Node canvas, outside ring/HUD/navigation/tool capture, with no valid paint ticket.

A source-generated DOWN is actually queued and admitted by the original native NODE_OT_link invocation. Physical serial, PAN classification and the fact that a DOWN was generated do not by themselves prove this native acceptance.

No outstanding tagged paint contact suppresses ordinary generation. Original Node handler remains live and receives the event in its original valid context; these delivery/ownership conditions are not established merely by the producer branch.

distinct_paths.entry_condition: handlePan is invoked with Cancelled or Failed while touchStreamAllowed is true, with the ordinary-corridor preconditions above.
source_sequence: UserInputEvent.cancelled defaults false. Ordinary route copies paint contact, which is invalid for this corridor.
Terminal assignment is valid_paint_contact AND state_is_not_Ended, so cancelled remains false. It queues LEFT_BUTTON_UP, without a terminal CURSOR_MOVE.
Generator passes cancelled=false to actual GHOST_EventButton. WM ingress yields LEFTMOUSE/KM_RELEASE and does not set WM_EVENT_IS_POINTER_CANCEL.

If delivered to still-live original native Node handler under the default evaluated map, LMB RELEASE translates to CONFIRM. Node Confirm uses prior-motion endpoints, can open search, commits complete links, returns FINISHED and follows native finished/history/cleanup.
distinct_paths.conclusion: Source predicts normal Confirm for that delivered callback. It does not prove that UIKit delivers this ordering or that the original handler receives it on an iPad.

distinct_paths.entry_condition: cancelPointerCapture executes while an ordinary untagged Node contact is active and before its terminal callback.
source_sequence: It emits a canceled UP for pencil_paint_enqueued_down only when a tagged paint down is recorded. Ordinary untagged Node does not acquire that record.
It interrupts both active recognizers through TouchAdmission.interrupt. This is a persistent admission bit until recognizer reset.

Ring cancellation is separate. PointerCapture.finish(true) emits UP only for active Navigation/WorkspaceResize/ToolManipulation capture. Ordinary canvas has PointerCaptureKind::None, so finish returns release=false.
With neither tagged paint nor active PointerCapture, this function emits no ordinary LMB terminal. Later handlePan callbacks return at touchStreamAllowed before emitting any packet until reset.
distinct_paths.conclusion: Source does not supply an ordinary Node terminal on this path. Whether another native event cancels/finishes/removes the original handler depends on the actual interruption and native delivery, not this helper alone.

metadata_emission_and_consumption.finding: Cancellation metadata is present for tagged paint terminals and active captured pointer terminals; ordinary allowed Cancelled/Failed sets it false. Explicit capture invalidation has no ordinary queued-DOWN receipt and emits no ordinary terminal.

GHOST_EventButton preserves is_cancelled. Actual WM ButtonUp ingress sets WM_EVENT_IS_POINTER_CANCEL when true, retains release type/value and prevents cross-window cursor retargeting for canceled packets. This path does not lose metadata that was actually emitted.

The special cancel callback interception is gated by handler->ipad_pencil_paint_serial or explicit paint teardown. Actual binder admits only the four native sculpt/paint modes and operators; zero-initialized NODE_OT_link handler is not bound. The Node PAN denial policy supplies no contact lease.

Native node_link_modal has no POINTER_CANCEL inspection. Default Node map maps LMB RELEASE to CONFIRM and RMB/Esc PRESS to CANCEL. Even an independently flagged untagged LMB release, if it reached this same ordinary Node corridor, would still use Confirm. This counterfactual is not an instruction to synthesize such a release.

inheritance_conclusion.finding: Existing inherited frontier, not a newly established a2b7 Knife or Node regression. All three historical reconstructions have identical cancelPointerCapture and ordinary terminal blocks, paint-only binding and interruption-dispatch fragments, and modal-map translation bodies. Entire current GHOST_WindowIOS matches prior3d7b248 exactly; older3438226 differs elsewhere.

original_vs_replacement_and_graph_semant: A valid ordinary DOWN and current registered NODE_OT_link name do not prove that an arbitrary current modal handler owns that contact. No current ordinary receipt ties the physical source contact to a particular accepted native Node handler lifetime.

Original context is substantive: native Node cancel reads CTX space/region, resets snode.runtime.linkdrag, and updates that edittree. A future caller must establish original live window/screen/area/region/space/tree and original drag affinity before touching this callback; a same-type replacement handler or same address after reuse is insufficient.

Existing generic operator/type lifetimes and native handler context are available mechanisms, not an already-established Node contact lease. Operator lifetime allocation is not proof of native acceptance. No broadening of the paint lease or global per-operator storage follows this audit.

Native Node Cancel is not graph rollback: existing-input init copies/removes the original native link; cancel destroys drag state without re-adding it, then returns CANCELLED without the native finished Undo push. Finish adds complete endpoints, may replace existing links and uses native history. Source/stock graph results must retain these distinctions.

A late/duplicate/foreign terminal must never be redirected to a replacement handler or a different context. The absence of an original owner must not be repaired by finding another NODE_OT_link, searching modalhandlers.first, or firing an unleased shared release.

smallest_next_coherent_frontier.objective: Characterize one ordinary untagged Pencil source contact through a genuinely admitted native Node link owner and its interruption, preserving exact native terminal graph/history semantics. This is a connected prerequisite audit, not a ready production helper.
before_any_coding: Define and review the intended interruption semantics separately from native Cancel graph rollback; the current evidence does not authorize inventing restored links, Undo pushes or replacement Cancel behavior.

Demonstrate exact current producer output for normal End, allowed Cancelled/Failed, and cancelPointerCapture-before-terminal, including actual queue order and whether DOWN was enqueued. No PAN/pressure/physical serial can stand in for admission.

Demonstrate real chosen keymap, native poll, preallocation refusal and actual socket init result; prove that this specific invocation really inserted a registered native NODE_OT_link handler. Refused/no-socket/PASS_THROUGH must establish no owner.

Establish a bounded original accepted-contact-to-handler lifetime relationship only after genuine admission. Revalidate actual native type/callback identity and original live context/space/tree/runtime drag before terminal action. Existing generic identities may be evaluated; do not broaden unrelated storage merely to make a check convenient.

Specify no-owner, already-finished, freed/replaced, pointer-reused and context-invalid behavior before any helper. No stale terminal may close another modal tool, and no mismatched event may be claimed as owned.

Prove normal release still confirms with current packets/order/coordinates, native terminal cleanup happens once, and cancellation/finish graph semantics remain native. Preserve custom/ambiguous fallback, native RMB/Esc/Alt, multi-input/socket rules and all accepted input/UI/lifetime contracts.

connected_verification_obligations.cases: End, Cancelled, Failed; explicit capture invalidation before each terminal; no down queued; queued but native poll/socket init refused.
connected_verification_obligations.must_execute: Current production callback/TouchAdmission/generator/GHOST packet fields and actual WM button ingress under explicit host SDK boundaries. Read native packet/event data; counters or a fixture admission boolean cannot prove owner creation.

connected_verification_obligations.cases: Native fresh-link and existing-input link acquired through real keymap/poll/init/modal registration; successful original context retained.
connected_verification_obligations.must_execute: Actual registered Node operator callbacks and handler registration, socket/graph effects and ordinary modal/terminal cleanup. A matched idname, injected test handler or mocked node_link_init is a disclosed boundary, not acceptance proof.

connected_verification_obligations.cases: Original still live; already Confirmed/Cancelled; original freed; new same-type handler; allocator address reuse; original area/region/tree replaced or removed; another pointer/window interrupts; duplicate old tail.
connected_verification_obligations.must_execute: Membership, native lifetime/callback identity and context/drag affinity checks without stale dereference; evidence that no replacement receives a semantic terminal and old tails are not replayed into another gesture.

connected_verification_obligations.cases: Fresh full/empty endpoints, native search delivery/discard; existing-input detach empty, return original and rewire; native RMB/Esc Cancel; real Undo/Redo after true Finish.
connected_verification_obligations.must_execute: Actual graph endpoint/order snapshots, original-handler cleanup and native history. Source predicts detached originals can stay removed on Cancel; no generic rollback assertion.

smallest_next_coherent_frontier.evidence_limits: Prior14-case source characterizer leaves native init/graph/history behind named boundaries. Newly completed stock5.1.2 graph/history runs establish that stock baseline independently; public event_simulate has no UIKit interruption, source contact lease or pointer-cancel metadata input. Neither replaces the missing connected target ordinary-owner interruption proof. No unchanged native build is warranted by this read-only contract.
